newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila feed millers reject bids for 55,000 T corn.
newsitem.headline: Manila feed millers reject bids for 55,000 T corn.

text.p: The Philippine Association of Feed Millers Inc on Monday sought new tenders for 55,000 tonnes of yellow corn after rejecting bids last week, Manila grains traders said.
"We were invited to submit fresh bids at 2 p.m. (0600 GMT) today," a trader told Reuters.
On Friday, the group was said to be negotiating with Continental Grains Co to lower its $137.50 per tonne C&F bid for U.S. yellow corn number 2.
Talk in the market said the feed millers asked Continental to cut its price to around $133 per tonne C&F.
But Continental rejected the proposal as U.S. corn prices rallied last Friday following bullish USDA weekly export sales and gains in soybeans, traders said.
